capabilities: List open notes as vertical tabs in the sidebar
Colour tabs manually or by folder
Filter and switch between open tabs by typing
Reopen recently closed tabs and save tab sets
disambiguation: Not about indentation or tab characters; it lists open notes as vertical tabs in the sidebar.
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Every setting also appears in Obsidian's settings search.
problem: Obsidian's horizontal tab bar gets crowded and makes it hard to see which notes are open, especially with many tabs or a split editor.

relations.evidence: The tab list then sits under Notebook Navigator (or the file explorer) in the same sidebar
Hold Cmd/Ctrl and hover to preview a note (uses the core Page preview plugin)

summary: Sidebar panel that lists all open notes as vertical tabs, with colours, pinning, filtering, recently closed tabs and saved tab sets.
